name: Overlay Navbar with Char-Wave & Emerald Pill CTA
border_spec: 1px solid #1E1E1E bottom hairline; 1px solid #61CE70 CTA border
interaction_spec: Sticky class toggles past 20px scroll; char-wave hover (0.4s ease, 0.05s/char stagger); dropdown slides to top:75px; < 1200px mobile drawer
a11y_requirements: Skip link before nav; aria-expanded on dropdown triggers; Escape key closes submenus

name: Circular Radial-Fill & Magnetic Outline CTA
interaction_spec: Cursor-origin radial emerald circle expansion (0.7s) + +/-80px magnetic GSAP pull (0.5s power2.out)
a11y_requirements: Clear emerald focus-visible ring; disable magnetic pull on coarse pointers & reduced motion

name: Circular Video Modal & Cursor Play Trigger
interaction_spec: Centered play glyph opening modal lightbox (.modal-show); paired desktop-only .cursor-testi 80->100px 'Play' circle
a11y_requirements: aria-label='Play showcase video'; native <dialog> modal restores trigger focus

name: Emerald Full-Bleed Swiper Marquee Strip
interaction_spec: Swiper freemode loop (.roll__slider speed:2000ms autoplay delay:1, breakpoints 1/3/4/5/8 slides)
a11y_requirements: Pause on hover/focus + explicit pause control; static chip grid under reduced-motion

name: Sticky 15deg Preview + Ribbon-Wipe Service Row
interaction_spec: Row hover rotates preview image from -100px to rotate(15deg) translate(60px,30px) in 0.5s + 175x70px -26deg green ribbon span in 0.3s
a11y_requirements: Mirror mouse hover state on :focus-visible; avoid un-cleared setInterval mousemove handlers

name: Oversized Bounce-Drop Count-Up Stat Block
interaction_spec: Drops from y:-100 via GSAP bounce easing (1.5s, stagger 0.3s) + counter digit roll
a11y_requirements: Expose final value in aria-label; skip bounce & count-up under reduced motion

name: MixItUp Filter Pill & Velocity-Skew Portfolio Card
interaction_spec: Filter buttons filter grid; scroll velocity skews images -15..15deg; hover slides .portfolio__content-5 right:-70->-50px (0.5s)
a11y_requirements: Use dark #020617 ink on active #65BC7B pills; mirror overlay slide on :focus-within

name: 8-Card Bordered Capability Tile
interaction_spec: ScrollTrigger vertical entry (.animation__feature2 y:40->0 power4.out stagger 0.3s); subtle border highlight
a11y_requirements: Semantic H3 under H2; SVG icons inherit currentColor

name: SVG Interactive Coverage Map + Country Marquee
interaction_spec: Hovering landmass reveals active region highlight and floating tooltip card
a11y_requirements: Pair with accessible semantic <ul> list of supported markets for keyboard & AT access

name: Pre-Footer Consultation Band & 4-Col Footer
interaction_spec: Footer links transition smoothly to #3BC77B; bottom text-shadow hover mirrors .menu-text
a11y_requirements: Single semantic <footer> landmark; >= 44x44px social hit areas

name: Dual Difference-Blend Cursor & Contextual Followers
interaction_spec: Desktop (>1200px) mousemove tracks clientX/Y via GSAP power2.out/power4.out with contextual labels on galleries & video posters
a11y_requirements: Hidden <= 1200px, pointer-events: none; never replaces semantic buttons or focusable targets

name: Character-Wave Stacked Text-Shadow Menu Link
interaction_spec: JS splits characters into spans shifting translateY over 0.4s ease with +0.05s incremental nth-child delay up to 1.5s
a11y_requirements: Disable cascade under prefers-reduced-motion; maintain clean focus-visible ring

name: Dark Rounded Action Pill (.wc-btn-dark)
interaction_spec: Inverts fill and border to #FFFFFF on hover over 0.3s
a11y_requirements: Ensure high contrast resting surface when placed on dark bands

name: ScrollTrigger Pinned Title & Sidebar Wrapper
interaction_spec: ScrollTrigger pin (.portfolio__title-wrap-6, .job__detail-sidebar) holds header/sidebar while sibling grid scrolls cleanly
a11y_requirements: Ensure scroll-margin-top prevents obscured focusable links; release pin safely on mobile widths
